mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear night at Harriet Park with a waxing crescent moon above. If you are an early bird, the International Space Station will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 4:47 AM, rising in the south over Belleville and traveling toward the east toward Fitchburg while staying low on the horizon. Expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking new volunteers, and road construction on Highway M begins August 18. This project will shift traffic lanes while crews work on underground utilities, so expect daytime flagging during the first few weeks.

We have plenty going on with music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today, alongside the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems or some yoga at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, on August 5, officers located a Madison man at a residence on Whalen Road for a probation violation, resulting in his arrest after he attempted to flee.
Today's flavor is the refreshing Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed, but they will be back open tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
